messages:
alex m: Quick sync on Sentinel postmortem follow-ups: VPC peering flaps -> route staleness. Need owners, dates, and verification plan.

maria g: I9ll take vendor/carrier coordination. Vendor mentioned firmware v1.2.9 (beta) fixes rapid-reconnect backoff. Will confirm GA timeline by 2026-04-01.

sanjay r: I9ll own the controller changes: per-peer KV sync lock, debounce before route cleanup, and safelist for recently restarted peers. ETA: PR by 2026-03-28.

julia ops: I9ll run the canary: two staging tenants, synthetic flap generator, verbose peer logs, and a new Grafana panel peering_flap_rate. Canary start target 2026-03-30.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary cluster provisioned 1729008000, logging and metrics enabled.

sanjay r: Repro steps posted in RW-8120: drop peer then reconnect <2s during KV sync. Log sample: ```ERROR tenant-iso: detected overlapping-kv-sync -> stale-route```	will attach full traces and a minimal repro script.

alex m: Short-term mitigation: skip aggressive route prune for peers restarted within 5m and emit high-sev alert for route anomalies. Sanjay please include latency/cost tradeoffs in RFC.

maria g: Customer accepted maintenance 2026-03-31 01:00 UTC. Vendor will attempt v1.2.9 push; if not GA, we'll flip local backoff config as fallback.

julia ops: Added recurring alert: flap_count >3 in 24h -> auto-create incident + tag oncall. Also weekly peering digest job.

alex m: Reconvene 2026-04-02 to review canary + maint outcome. Closing criteria: merged controller PR + 72h clean canary + firmware roll or validated fallback.

sanjay r: Will post PR URL and CI/integration logs here when ready.

maria g: Looping in CS with maintenance window notes and vendor SLA details.
